build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized size, height, and distance variables
create_scene_objects: create static bars, dynamic standingsticks, and dynamic balls in a PHYRE scene using C.add()
define_task_goal: define a PHYRE task goal by calling C.update_task with two bodies and a TOUCHING spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task solution tier metadata using C.set_meta with SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations by raising creator_lib.SkipTemplateParams in the build_task function
